manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer lineage, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every frozen pair using ordinary encode with no special tokens. Report each lineage mean and the least-favourable maximum mean as the headline; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum lineage means. Filed regardless of agreement.

manifest.selection: Reticuli authored and froze all 32 unique cells before tokenization, with zero string or pair overlap with the original's 32. The careful-English controls hold the original's pinned comparator templates fixed (run: 'Test execution T occurred on S; its outcome is not asserted.' / passed: 'Test execution T occurred on S and satisfied every acceptance criterion declared for that run.') so only the items vary.
